content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Regulatory Compliance Strategy & Cross-Border Payment Infrastructure Review
agenda_items: Discussion of SOC 2 Type II audit findings and remediation timeline
Review of proposed budget allocation for compliance technology upgrades
Timeline for implementing enhanced KYC verification protocols across all markets
key_decisions: Approved enhanced due diligence protocols for high-risk merchant categories effective within 60 days
Deferred expansion into Mexican market pending regulatory clarity on digital payment licensing
Mandated completion of FINTRAC compliance gap analysis within 45 days with external audit partner
action_items: Marcus Okonkwo to engage external counsel for FINTRAC compliance assessment and provide cost estimate within 2 weeks
Leila Andersson to develop detailed remediation plan for SOC 2 findings with resource requirements within 21 days
Priya Deshmukh to coordinate vendor selection process for transaction monitoring platform and present top 3 options within 30 days
